inputs.style: Thrash Metal, aggressive and precise, fast-paced. Features rapid double-bass drumming, complex odd-time signature riffs, galloping rhythm guitar, and a high-pitched, screaming male vocal delivery. Short and punchy.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Tighten the laces, sharpen the blade
Chasing the thunder, never to fade
Rapid fire rhythm, cutting the air
Punching the gut, hitting us there

[Chorus]
Iron strings! Cutting deep
Pulling the strings while the city sleeps
Iron strings! Wake the dead
Puppets dancing on a steel head
